nodes.name: news-scan stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:10 UTC (08:40 IST, Mon-Sat). Triggers news-background; also self throttles to one run per 10 minutes via the last-news-run blob so public re-triggers cannot force reruns.

nodes.name: post-open-scan stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:50 UTC (09:20 IST, Mon-Fri). Triggers the post-open confirmation snapshot in scan-background with the post-open header.

nodes.name: scan-background worker
nodes.summary: The 15 minute budget worker for the daily scan and the post-open confirmation. Rejects headerless public POSTs (403), stores the report as JSON/markdown/HTML in blobs, updates the framework scorecard and computes the summary in memory to dodge blob read-after-write staleness.

nodes.name: stocks-adaptive-background worker
nodes.summary: Runs the per stock learning cycle: resolves pending predictions against real closes, relearns per stock parameters and emits the next session forecasts into the stocks-live blob. Same 30 minute public throttle pattern.

nodes.name: stocks-adaptive stub
nodes.summary: Scheduled 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST, Mon-Sat; Saturday catches the Friday US close). Triggers stocks-adaptive-background with a 10 minute stub guard.

nodes.name: Root local test
nodes.summary: Smoke test runner for the local function stack from the project root.

nodes.name: Model analysis builder
nodes.summary: Offline: learns the ensemble weight from the TimesFM and LSTM forecast histories and writes assets/model-analysis.json.

nodes.name: Search index builder
nodes.summary: Builds assets/search-index.json from the 7 content pages (tags stripped) plus the 95 glossary terms imported from the real module, so search covers the glossary with anchors. Run after any content change.

nodes.name: Exhibit builder
nodes.summary: Python: builds the HPQ validation exhibit data from the article dataset.

nodes.name: Model packer
nodes.summary: Python: reads the trained Keras LSTM weights and emits the base64 packed blob consumed by lib/model-nifty.mjs.

nodes.name: Adaptivity proof
nodes.summary: Replays the walk-forward with the adaptive layer on and off to measure the honest gain (+0.3 to +1.1 points) and band coverage (77.97 percent).

nodes.name: Offline data fetcher
nodes.summary: Python: pulls per stock history from Nasdaq, Yahoo and Alpha Vantage with fallbacks and paces requests; feeds the offline TimesFM runs.

nodes.name: Style auditor
nodes.summary: Audits all shipped text for em dashes, buzzwords and style rule violations with an allowlist for numbers, tickers and ISO dates.

nodes.name: Local end-to-end test
nodes.summary: Boots the functions locally with netlify dev style stubs and checks the report pipeline.

nodes.name: News engine test
nodes.summary: Runs one real news cycle locally against the live sources and asserts headline counts, symbol feed health and earnings parsing. The NEWS_ENGINE_OK gate.

nodes.name: Stocks engine test
nodes.summary: Simulates the adaptive cycle against a fake blob store and asserts prediction resolution and relearning.

nodes.name: TimesFM runner
nodes.summary: Python: batches the 50 symbols through TimesFM 2.5 offline and writes the forecast artifact.

nodes.name: LSTM validator
nodes.summary: Loads the packed NIFTY model, runs the 5 session forecast and compares against the recorded training-time outputs to prove the JS port is bit faithful.

nodes.name: storeReport
nodes.summary: Writes the report as JSON, markdown and HTML blobs for the archive, the API and the latest view.

nodes.name: postOpenConfirmation
nodes.summary: The 09:20 snapshot: what actually happened after the bell, merged into today's stored report.

nodes.name: summaryFrom
nodes.summary: Computes the summary in memory after storing, dodging the blob read-after-write staleness bug.
